packaged_workflow_scope: Exact installed collector, disposable local data, accounts disabled, browser skipped. These checks are separate from the live desktop results below.
signing: Existing Developer ID with hardened runtime. Strict signature checks passed. No new secure timestamp or notarization; separate from the historical App Store candidate.
changes_since_build55: Preserve usage precision until display so percentages are rounded only once.
Do not alert on an old ChatGPT assistant branch selected after monitoring starts; preserve reviewed state and exact conversation identity.
Recover Claude account-reader busy state and ChatGPT worker slots when thread creation fails.
Handle Claude reply markers arriving while the same turn is still running, including restart and same-second turn boundaries, without consuming completion early.
Update local About and Privacy disclosures to describe the current account readers and transient latest-turn checks.

live_workflows.build56_claude_desktop: A new reply in an existing ordinary Claude desktop chat appeared once as Cooking, then Ready while the desktop app showed its Code pane. The completed reply was confirmed in Claude. Reviewed survived a normal Agent Board quit and reopen.
live_workflows.build56_final_state: All five sources connected after restart. Current Codex work and a running Claude project appeared as Cooking. Both providers displayed fresh, aligned whole-number usage. The corrected About and expanded Privacy content rendered and returned to the board.
live_workflows.build55_controls: Local rename, ten-minute snooze, restart persistence, new short reply clearing snooze, restoring the automatic title, Reviewed, Restore, and source disable/re-enable were exercised through the desktop app. Re-enabling the source retained Reviewed state.
live_workflows.build55_storage_recovery: The live collector encountered actual full-disk failures, showed disconnected or last-known state, and recovered in the same running process after regenerable build caches were cleared. The completed test reply became Ready.
live_workflows.build55_soak: Twenty read-only samples over five minutes showed all five sources available and collector heartbeat ages below 2.2 seconds, with no new log errors.
live_workflows.earlier_web_evidence: Build53 exercised real short replies in both provider web apps and exact-chat handoff. Web paths were not rerun for56 because this pass was restricted to desktop apps.
live_workflows.earlier_chatgpt_desktop_evidence: An earlier bounded reader confirmed a completed reply from a user-created desktop test chat. Its saved card remains accessible. A fresh complete ChatGPT desktop submission lifecycle is still unverified.
live_workflows.notifications: The native test-notification action reported no delivery error. A visible notification banner was not independently confirmed.

supporting_tests.native_lifetime: Eleven native reader and parent-lifetime fixture cases passed on55; CollectorRuntime.swift is byte-identical in56. These cases were not rerun.
supporting_tests.regressions: Historical branch selection, reply settlement ordering, same-second turn boundaries, restarts, failed storage writes, source identity deduplication, worker-start recovery, usage rounding, account isolation, bounded network responses, and privacy checks are covered by the automated suite.

limitations: A fresh ChatGPT desktop prompt-to-board lifecycle is unverified because Computer Use cannot control the app hosting the session. No alternate control path was used.
Visible native notification delivery, a clean recipient installation, new notarization, and a complete minimum-OS run remain unverified.
Provider account readers require the matching existing sign-in on this Mac and use interfaces that can change.
Discovery is bounded to 100 recent conversations per provider; ChatGPT status checks are bounded to 256 identities and latest-turn reads to 3 MiB.
A first-seen ChatGPT reply that began before monitoring may remain unconfirmed without a provider finish timestamp or prior reply baseline.
Provider errors, rate limits, and delayed settlement metadata can temporarily delay status or usage updates. Unconfirmed activity is not presented as verified completion.
This is an engineering backup and local repair candidate, not App Store approval or unrestricted distribution readiness.
release_assessment: Local candidate installed and tested. Public launch readiness remains unconfirmed because the desktop, notification, and distribution checks listed above are incomplete.
publication_scope: Allowlisted application source, source manifest, build receipt, and compiled app. No live databases, account credentials, private chat records, raw logs, screenshots, or private repository history.
